assertions.evidence: In src/leadRouting.ts, routeLead checks headcount and regions before any model call: if (lead.headcount > ENTERPRISE_HEADCOUNT) ...; if (lead.regions.length >= ENTERPRISE_REGION_COUNT) ...; only otherwise does it call client.alpha.decisions.create(...).
The code pins the model ID and uses the Decisions API: const MODEL = "typesafe/jev-1.13-20260917"; then client.alpha.decisions.create({ decisionsRequest: { model: MODEL, ... } }).
The state sent excludes headcount and regions: state: { lead: { company: lead.company, free_text: lead.freeText } } in src/leadRouting.ts.
